signature: SUBROUTINE ZGETSQRHRT( M, N, MB1, NB1, NB2, A, LDA, T, LDT, WORK, LWORK, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $M \ge N \ge 0$.

params.name: mb1
params.reference: The row block size to be used in the blocked TSQR. $\mathrm{MB1} > N$.

params.name: nb1
params.reference: The column block size to be used in the blocked TSQR. $N \ge \mathrm{NB1} \ge 1$.

params.name: nb2
params.reference: The block size to be used in the blocked QR that is output. $\mathrm{NB2} \ge 1$.

params.name: A
params.reference:
On entry: an M-by-N matrix A.

On exit: a) the elements on and above the diagonal

-   of the array contain the N-by-N upper-triangular
-   matrix R corresponding to the Householder QR;

b) the elements below the diagonal represent Q by

the columns of blocked V (compact WY-representation).

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The upper triangular block reflectors stored in compact form as a sequence of upper triangular blocks.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \mathrm{NB2}$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: (workspace) COMPLEX\*16 array, dimension (MAX(1,`LWORK`)) On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max ( \mathrm{LWT} + \mathrm{LW1}, \max ( \mathrm{LWT}+N \, N+\mathrm{LW2}, \mathrm{LWT}+N \, N+N ) )$, where

$$
\mathrm{NUM\_ALL\_ROW\_BLOCKS} = \mathrm{CEIL}((M-N)/(\mathrm{MB1}-N))
$$

$$
\mathrm{NB1LOCAL} = \min (\mathrm{NB1},N)
$$

$$
\mathrm{LWT} = \mathrm{NUM\_ALL\_ROW\_BLOCKS} \, N \, \mathrm{NB1LOCAL}
$$

$$
\mathrm{LW1} = \mathrm{NB1LOCAL} \, N
$$

$$
\mathrm{LW2} = \mathrm{NB1LOCAL} \, \max ( \mathrm{NB1LOCAL}, ( N - \mathrm{NB1LOCAL} ) )
$$

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed. The routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local LWORKOPT is assigned inside nested control flow
